svg.aria-label: clowk architecture: catch credentials at the paste boundary, file them locally, and use one without ever reading its value
svg.title: clowk — architecture
svg.text: clowk
catches credentials you paste into an agent chat, before the model sees them
0.3.0 · no daemon, no proxy, no encryption
a capture-and-bookkeeping tool —
deliberately not a security boundary
real value
reference only
clowk component
blocked
THE ONE THING THAT PREVENTS A LEAK · BUILT AND VERIFIED LIVE
YOU PASTE
sk_live_4eC39Hq…
into the chat
nothing has been sent
to the provider yet
HOOK · LOCAL
UserPromptSubmit
222 rules, keyword +
entropy gated, before
anything is sent
ON A HIT
the turn is BLOCKED — the model
receives nothing. No other part of
this design prevents a leak.
the host still writes the raw prompt to its own
transcript on disk — rotate a blocked key anyway
YOU GET BACK
$STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
your prompt, rewritten and already on
your clipboard. Repaste is one keystroke.
the only friction here, and unavoidable: a hook can
block a prompt but cannot rewrite one in place
THE STORE
~/.clowk/vault.json
mode 0600 · one file · plaintext
Out of settings.local.json — so it is not in every session's
env, and not in a directory anyone might commit.
Plaintext on purpose: encryption cannot help when the agent
runs as you and the key must be reachable by the same user.
THE LEDGER AND THE CLI
clowk add · get · set · list · clear · rename · uses · allow
add lets a human type a key at the terminal instead of
pasting it into a chat. list never prints a value.
Every clowk get is recorded with its directory, so uses
shows what has drawn on a credential since it was caught.
USING ONE · THE VALUE REACHES THE COMMAND, NEVER THE TRANSCRIPT
THE ONLY CORRECT FORM
psql "$(clowk get DATABASE_URL)"
The shell expands it and hands the value to
the command's arguments. Nothing wraps anything.
THE GUARD · PreToolUse
a bare call, echo, a pipe, a redirect, or
capture into a variable — each denied
a process cannot tell it was substituted
THE SKILL
~/.claude/skills/clowk/SKILL.md
Never read, print or store a plain value. The
pointer to it rides in the repasted prompt.
DEFENCE IN DEPTH · PreToolUse DENY — CHEAP, REAL, AND NOT A BOUNDARY
vault.json · .env · *.pem · id_rsa · .netrc · git credential fill · security find-generic-password
git credential fill printed a live token from the keychain during this project's design review — one line, no attack. It denies running these, not mentioning them.
WHAT THIS STOPS
a pasted key reaching the model or the provider
the key living in every session's env, in a committable directory
not knowing what has drawn on a key when you have to rotate it
the agent printing a value it was handed a reference to
the easy accidents: .env, a private key, git credential fill
WHAT IT DOES NOT
a same-user read. Whatever clowk can read, cat can read.
the blocked prompt on disk — the host writes that itself
a file you @-mention, or Grep showing contents to the model
a credential in a format the 222 rules do not recognise
a real boundary needs a separate OS user, a container, or a signed binary
